description: Checks a list of holdings for known index overlap and related fund mandates, using issuer reference records (asset class, region, structure). Findings are worded exactly as the Portfolio Optimizer Pro grade states them. Overlap here is category-based (similar stated mandates); it is not a measured percentage of shared underlying holdings, and the result says so.

holdings.description: The portfolio: 1 to 30 holdings, each ticker once, with its weight.

ticker.description: Fund or company ticker symbol as listed on a US exchange, e.g. "VTI".

weight.description: Share of the portfolio. Percent (60 = 60%) or fraction (0.6); weights are normalized to total 100%.

name: check_overlap

known_index_overlap.description: Fund-overlap findings exactly as the grade states them; any one caps the grade.

title: Check fund overlap
